definitions.explanation: The act of creating or establishing something new, such as an institution, facility, department, or system. Also used as a modifier to describe something newly created.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{学部|がくぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{新設|しんせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{新設|しんせつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A nursery school was newly established in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{災害|さいがい}{対策|たいさく}→災害対策：25766_saigaitaisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新設|しんせつ}⟦{機関|きかん}→機関：02630_kikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦{発足|ほっそく}→発足：13641_hossoku⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧だ。
examples.english: The government plans to launch a newly established agency for disaster response next year.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru verb ({新設|しんせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) or as a noun modifier ({新設|しんせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧). The homophone ⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧ (kindness) is a completely different word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{新設|しんせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to newly establish a school
- {新設|しんせつ}⟦{部門|ぶもん}→部門：14406_bumon⟧: newly created department
- {新設|しんせつ}{校|こう}: newly built school
- {新設|しんせつ}⟦{合併|がっぺい}→合併：04778_gappei⟧: new merger

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{設立|せつりつ}→設立：14171_setsuritsu⟧: establishment, founding (more general)
- ⟦{創設|そうせつ}→創設：11905_sousetsu⟧: founding, creation (emphasizes being the first)
